tldr: Chiron transiting the 6th house: a long healing chapter around work, routine, health, service, and daily maintenance.
body: Chiron moving through the 6th house can reopen old material around work, routine, health, service, and daily maintenance. This is usually a long season, not a quick event, and it asks for patient work with the sore place rather than a rushed fix. The wound is in work, routine, and health, often showing through the body or a sense of daily inadequacy.
business: For a year or more, the Chiron wound works through work, routine, health, service, and daily maintenance. You become a healer or fixer who knows the body and the grind from the inside.
shadow: Overworking the body, or letting health stand in for the deeper wound.
advice: Tend the sore spot in the 6th house deliberately. Work with work, routine, health, service, and daily maintenance as a healing chapter, not a crisis to fix fast.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Chiron house placement material.
